caption: The drawing contains three distinct wooden objects arranged across the central part of a plain, off-white background. All three objects appear to be illustrations of carved wood puzzles or ornaments in various geometric forms, rendered in shades of light and medium brown with fine, dark line detailing. The object on the left stands upright and features a ring at the top, beneath which is a cuboid central section edged with a circular base, with a sphere encased inside a rectangular frame. The object on the right is also upright and has a looped ring at the top, below which a long, open frame encases two balls stacked vertically, transitioning into a rounded, three-lobed lower section. The third object is positioned horizontally at the bottom left and consists of a flared, conical end tapering into a long, open lattice, inside which are two spheres, with a small hook attached to one sphere near the flared end. The overall composition places the upright objects toward the top center, while the horizontal object is near the lower left. Each piece shows careful shading and highlights consistent with a wooden appearance. In the bottom right, the name “Rex Bush” is written in small, cursive text.
title: Wooden Toys
